policy: DEV-ONLY lint toolchain. Nothing here is a runtime dependency: the engine's Node code (tools/graphify, tools/lib, tools/mermaid-engine) has zero third-party runtime deps by design, and node_modules/ is gitignored and regenerated on demand. Upgrades re-run `npm run lint:js` and re-derive this hash.
_review: Reviewed before attesting, 2026-08-23, because an attestation asserted without reading the lockfile is a signature on an unread document. 70 packages, entirely eslint's transitive tree; ZERO carry an install script (`hasInstallScript`), which is the install-time code-execution surface that matters most for a lockfile nobody reads line by line. devDependencies only.
_why_this_file_exists: STRUCT-09 requires a sibling VERSION_LOCK.json for EVERY tracked npm lockfile, derived from `git ls-files` rather than a hardcoded path. This repository tracked two lockfiles while the check verified one, and a third (this one) arrived the same day the check was generalised — which is precisely the rot the generalisation exists to prevent, demonstrated within hours.
_review_2026_10_17: eslint ^10.9.0 -> ^10.12.0 and transitive brace-expansion bump (Dependabot); `npm run lint:js` clean, `npm audit` 0 vulnerabilities; lockfile hash re-derived.
